generation: One fresh container and ephemeral CLI session per condition/case; two new synthetic tasks, one answer per task/condition.
input_mode: Primary SKILL full text injected into user input. For Mermaid-only, main guide and matching reference; for visual-v041, primary plus Mermaid main and matching reference. No tools requested. Not an automatic skill loading evaluation.
model: Same official Codex CLI 0.162.0 default configuration; no model override, seed or sampling control. Actual serving model not recorded by CLI JSON events.
filesystem: Readonly root, assigned input only, no repo/peer mount, no Docker socket, uid1000, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges. Login-only auth volume at /credentials readonly; fresh CLI home in tmpfs.
network: Docker bridge and existing proxy for model requests; not egress isolated. Generation instructed not to use tools or fetch external content.
tools: Local model tool execution unavailable due namespace constraints; textual sources supplied directly, not discovered or dynamically loaded.
review: Root qualitative review with source labels visible, plus actual SVG/PNG rendering where renderer succeeds; no blinded user study.
limits: Only two synthetic cases, one sample per case/condition
CLI default may differ from previous agent default; no matched-model historical causal inference
Content injection comparison, not native skill invocation
Syntax validation separate from rendering; no automatic renderer currently requested
sources: Verbatim previous skill snapshots; new prompts and rubric fixed in /tmp/visual-challenge-source before generation.
